scope: Conditional whole-root-chart repair given a regular polynomial source coordinate on a canonical component open; coordinate existence and global alignment unproved.

primary_sources.locator: Displayed statement and proof, specifically comparison for the fppf topology and a quasi-coherent structure sheaf.
primary_sources.inspection: Primary statement and full displayed proof read. It identifies ordinary quasi-coherent cohomology with the corresponding fppf sheaf cohomology.
primary_sources.application: The already-established Ga torsor on A1 has class in H1_fppf(A1,Ga)=H1(A1,O).

primary_sources.inspection: Primary statement and full displayed proof read. Higher quasi-coherent cohomology vanishes on affine opens.

retained_inputs.locator: Sections2–4 for smooth affine whole component open M_i, disjoint closed source line, normalizationA1/topologicalC boundary, and finite-point coverage; Section5 for actual exact unit source volume.
Sections2–4 for regular source coordinate, unit-volume Hamiltonian extension, local nilpotence and whole-source preservation.

checked_hypotheses: Begin on the actual component open M_i=X union D_i; no normalized-cover smoothness assertion is made on all of U with unrelated boundary multiplicities.
Normalize z^r=y-lambda before asserting smoothness; locally at D_i the normal algebra is w^r=u, z=f*w.
Remove the whole source line and all but one copied boundary component; effective Cartier complements are affine.
The restricted normalized cover is etale, so its pulled-back volume is unit and defines the divided Hamiltonian directly.
A nonzero LND on an irreducible curve gives a slice and proves algebraic A1 without normality assumptions.
The torsor claim uses smooth surjectivity, one free orbit per fibre and the action-map isomorphism; freeness alone is not substituted.
Exactness uses a primitive on the SAME original component open, not only separately exact forms on two plane charts.
Separatedness of the same normalized cover forces the residual principal part to be nonzero.
adopted_foundations: Finite normalization of affine complex algebras, regularity of finite etale algebras and normality of regular schemes.
Finite etale unit-root covers are topological covers on complex points; a cover of the given topologicalC boundary splits.
Affineness local on the target for effective Cartier complements.
Algebraic Ga actions from LNDs, standard torsor classification by H1, and etale universally bijective morphisms being isomorphisms.
not_claimed: Existence of any regular source coordinate or one common across all components.
Global alignment of source coordinates, cyclic root choices, slices or Laurent principal parts.
Any global Xie/intersection bound or target-degree/companion-degree cutoff.
A genuine Keller target pair for the explicit affine control surfaces.
Formal verification, external human review or HC4/JC2 resolution.
